summary: A compact, playable transition: the headcount releases the minefield tension, then Shalabi immediately turns that relief into forward movement. The clipped exchange suits both men and the need for silence.
scene_issues: The tactile headcount must remain clear on camera so «كَامْ؟» is understood as asking how many men made it through, not how many were hurt.

lines.speaker: SHALABI
issues: Its meaning depends on the preceding headcount action, but the staging supplies that context.

performance.delivery: Keep it clipped and almost breathless, directed at Sayed as he reaches the rear of the file. Shalabi needs confirmation before he permits himself any relief.

lines.speaker: SAYED
issues: The initial vowel in «اتْأَذَى» is unmarked; fully marked text would use «اِتْأَذَى».

performance.delivery: Report directly to Shalabi without celebration. Let a trace of relief enter only on the second sentence; Sayed is still protecting the men by keeping them quiet and moving.
Take a brief beat on «رُمَّانَةْ», then indicate the bearing with the hand and finish firmly. The relief is over; Shalabi has already moved mentally to the next danger.
